Apply checks at edge, domain transaction, retrieval, tool dispatch and publication as applicable; hiding or disabling navigation is not authorization. Originating ACL filtering precedes text release to generation. Cross-tenant resource substitution returns the absent-resource not-found response class without disclosing private existence. heading_context: SF-009 — SCR-004 Run Timeline, drafting and tool activity
generated_evidence.quote_en: Browser-supplied arbitrary tool definitions are prohibited.
generated_evidence.normalized_proposition_en: Browser-supplied arbitrary tool definitions are prohibited.
generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: Planner DAG depth is **8**, maximum tool invocations **16**, explicit dependencies/replayable checkpoints, with stored plan revision before side effects. Triage, Research and Draft are bounded AI responsibilities; Policy Evaluator is deterministic. Browser-supplied arbitrary tool definitions are prohibited. Discovery and model text never confer action authority. Pinned approved MCP schemas validate arguments; external writes need separate capability permission; mutable operations need idempotency and, when consequential, human authorization. A denied action cannot be replaced by a semantically equivalent tool. [Source: pp.7,40–42; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c4:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c66:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c66:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c67:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c67:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c68:f4`]

corrected_generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: Each actual durable-state-changing boundary record carries `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and a correlation ID under the source's condition “wherever the operation changes durable state.” General tenant/actor boundary context remains required. These are not editable browser fields. Canonical event fields are separately `event_id`, `type`, `schema_version`, `tenant_id`, `aggregate_id`, `aggregate_revision`, `occurred_at`, `trace_id`, `payload`, using UTC/canonical JSON; aliases between the lists are not supplied. [Source: p.48 §13.1 and pp.57–59; `screen_functions:r1:c78:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c96:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c97:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c98:f7`]

At-least-once consumers check ledger/event identity and aggregate revision, record duplicate outcome and do not reapply mutation; delayed events are safe without cross-partition order reliance. Accepted transitions require one audit record and tenant-scoped traces; diagnostic telemetry excludes source text.
